scope.batching_limitation: Union batching and fresh-process segmentation differ from per-list execution; no bitwise equivalence is claimed.
scope.historical_provenance_limitation: Current-byte seals do not retroactively attest original vector inference or historical physical-volume identity. Retained retrieval hardware and fresh MPS float32 reranking remain distinct.
scope.interpretation: Descriptive same-cohort differences only; no significance, general winner, pooled accuracy, answer-generation, total-compute or online-latency claim.
scope.language_limitation: Inherited SDK lang=tr on English/French datasets; not language-matched settings.
scope.paired_difference: Laya minus matching None aggregate on the same ordered query cohort, subset and budget. None ranks the full retrieved union; Laya reranks its first K candidates. Differences include candidate cutoff and reranking.
scope.score_reuse: Energy is carried as a complete 308-query V2 summary, comprising 229 V4 and 79 V2 successful queries. Finance carries 231 V2 closed query records, including seven from an interrupted segment without a terminal child wait. V3 scores only the remaining 1382 queries. Receipt reads are not inference; unknown historical attempts are not zero.
